content:
The image shows a mango leaf with irregular whitish-gray powdery patches scattered across the surface. The patches are diffuse and dusty in appearance, not sunken or necrotic. No brown spots, black lesions, sooty encrustation, or gum secretion are visible.

This matches Powdery Mildew — the characteristic white powdery coating on leaf surfaces.
